Resolves #19568

The film tour's four machine-speed stretches now move at hand tempo through the screenplay's existing options, and the perspectives scene gets a reading beat after every outcome — including a new one after the mutation, which the undo used to overwrite on its own frame. Headless clock (the witness's beat log, now a 100 ms poll): native return 6.0 s (was 4.0), resize 2.4 s (was ≤ 2.0 at the old 1 s poll), showcase 7.2 s (was 5.0), perspectives capture → redo 9.9 s (was 6.0); total 56.2 s against the 47.0 s baseline, both at 9e48135295 on the same seat. The cue-free cap of 2026-09-23 moves from 1 s to 1.5 s — one bound shared with the born hold and the showcase dwell — and the screenplay header records the operator's brief (the narration whole; the picture sized to carry it) in place of "the voice is cut to the motion". `targetSeconds` stay the budgets (91 s): the ticket's corrected Fix section says why.

Evidence: L3 (headless e2e + unit on the author's seat, own bridge) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-3); AC-4 is the headed take at the merged head, the epic's step. Residual: AC-4, Residual-Owner: #15252.
